authority: Article XXXVI §10 (AI loop must be demonstrated, not asserted)
purpose: Every TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY candidate must have an artifact preserving the full HYPOTHESIS→READY chain, including WHY each transition happened.

stages.name: MODEL
stages.description: A computational model is built to test the hypothesis.

stages.name: EXTERNAL_SIMULATOR
stages.description: The model is cross-checked against a standard engine from the Standard Simulator Registry (Article XXXVI §6).

stages.name: STRONGEST_COMPARATOR
stages.description: The best publicly known alternative is identified and run.

stages.name: ATTACK
stages.description: At least 3 hostile attacks (functional-equivalence, prior-art, mechanism-failure) are executed.

stages.name: FAIL
stages.description: First iteration is EXPECTED to fail. Failure is information.

stages.name: AI_DIAGNOSIS
stages.description: Failure is diagnosed: mechanism failure (Article XXIX §1) vs. implementation failure (Article XXIX §2).

stages.name: REPAIR
stages.description: If diagnosis is implementation failure, the model is repaired (within budget).

stages.name: RETEST
stages.description: The repaired model is re-run against the same pre-registered criterion.

stages.name: INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION
stages.description: The repaired model is verified against the standard engine (Article XXXVI §7).

stages.name: ECONOMIC_PROOF
stages.description: Economic model is built with evidence-tier labels (Article XXXVI §8).

stages.name: TTP
stages.description: Complete technology-transfer package is assembled (Article XXXVI §5).

transition_rule.statement: Each transition must preserve WHY it happened. The loop is not 'model ran → done.' The loop is 'model ran → attacked → repaired → independently verified → economically proven → packaged.'

transition_chain.rationale: Wash-out gating hypothesis proposed; PK model built to test.
Model output was tautological — the wash-out gate was defined to equal the drug-release trigger.
Article XXIX §1: mechanism failure. The model structure was invalid (circular definition), not a parameter bug.
Replace tautological model with real pharmacokinetic model (COPASI from Standard Simulator Registry).
Real PK model run; result: FAIL — drug concentration insufficient to achieve therapeutic effect.
Second failure is terminal (Article XXXVI §4). P-05 → cemetery. Lesson: wash-out gating does not produce therapeutic drug levels in CSF.

audit_requirement.statement: A candidate may not enter TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY without a complete ai_loop_provenance.json.
audit_requirement.enforcement: Pre-commit hook validates ai_loop_provenance.json exists and contains all 13 stages with transition_rationale for each.

what_this_is_NOT.statement: The provenance is not a marketing narrative. It is an audit trail. Failures are preserved. Repairs are explained. The point is to demonstrate the AI loop ran honestly, not to tell a success story.
